gloss: the four treasures of the study

definitions.gloss: the four treasures of the study (brush, ink, paper, inkstone)
definitions.explanation: The four essential tools of East Asian calligraphy and scholarship: brush, inkstick, paper and inkstone.

examples.japanese: {文房四宝|ぶんぼうしほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
examples.english: I collected the four treasures of the study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文房四宝|ぶんぼうしほう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Calligraphy tools are called the four treasures of the study.

examples.japanese: {文房四宝|ぶんぼうしほう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧・⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧・⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧・⟦{硯|すずり}→硯：06124_suzuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことで、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にした。
examples.english: The four treasures of the study are brush, ink, paper and inkstone, and scholars of old prized them.

notes:
USAGE:
From Chinese: {文房|ぶんぼう} (a scholar's study) + {四宝|しほう} (four treasures). A formal, literary term; in a calligraphy class people simply say ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ or ⟦{習字|しゅうじ}→習字：04176_shuuji⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧.
